entries.estimatedFrom: BLS Current Employment Statistics, February 2023 pay-period prevalence
entries.limitation: Modal industry and establishment-size practice; first Friday is an estimated employer calendar until a recorded calendar replaces it.

entries.estimatedFrom: U.S. Constitution Amendment XIV; 8 USC 1401-1408; Covenant section 303
entries.limitation: Current birth-law rows cover all 56 places. Historical births before a row's applicability and unread birthplace evidence use modal Census county citizenship counts, with no invented oath date.

entries.estimatedFrom: Census ACS household composition, same-sex couple and educational-attainment tables; BLS occupational employment; NCSL legislator tenure
entries.limitation: Starting cohorts use aggregate apportionment. Education and occupation weights, child counts and starting tenure are reference estimates pending compiled subgroup observations.

entries.estimatedFrom: FEMA Hazus flood and hurricane technical manuals; NFIP depth-damage practice; NWS flood and wind hazard guidance
entries.limitation: Depth, wind, elevation, resistance, mobility and backup inputs govern consequences. Default physical capacities and injury-load bands are estimates, not calibrated local engineering or clinical observations.

entries.estimatedFrom: NOAA NCEI Storm Events 2000-2024 catalog and 2023-2024 detailed episode records
entries.limitation: Recorded season and county footprints replay without draws. Unread local catalog rates use the median recorded county-adjusted seasonal rate; detailed weather-zone crosswalk remains uncompiled.

entries.estimatedFrom: 28 USC 1861 and 1865; Federal Rule of Criminal Procedure 23(b)
entries.limitation: Recorded venire, excusals and trace-backed strikes take priority. Unread venire order follows prior recorded service and roster order as a marked administrative estimate.

entries.estimatedFrom: Compiled macro-regime reference frequencies in CRUNCH46 policy
entries.limitation: An existing opening regime is retained; an unread category takes the modal recorded reference regime.

entries.estimatedFrom: Federal Reserve Act, Board of Governors appointment and chair terms
entries.limitation: Member risk tendency supplies the price-versus-job view. An existing President chooses through the appointment engine; an opening without an appointer uses longest service as an estimated chair record.

entries.estimatedFrom: U.S. Constitution Article V and existing legislative session-calendar data
entries.limitation: State ratification dates follow the current shared session calendar after the recorded minimum lead time. Per-state sessions will remain marked reference calendars until compiled.
